title: SO-101 benchmark
subtitle: Menagerie's SO-101 model in place of the SO-100, benchmarked with the SO-100 baselines' exact recipe
why: The simulator used Menagerie's SO-100 with an SO-101 camera mount; the real arm is an SO-101. Menagerie's SO-101 (box and sphere collision pads) fixes the August convex-hull failure of the official model. Both SO-101 scenes keep the SO-100's calibrated camera and jaw-tip sites (within 0.2 mm and 0.001 deg), the measured joint map in the SO-101's conventions (exact, no new measurement) and the teacher's settings; the teacher certifies 30/30 on both. One scene keeps the bench's dynamics, the other Menagerie's (kp 998, 0.005 s, implicitfast).
